text:
Wretched, poor, alone, and beaten down,

I live in this unhappy populated wasteland,

and since being unfortunate is no choice,

I am ashamed of being so unfortunate.


Reason is of no use, nor has it been useful

to one ruled by the cruelty of fate,

for care is sometimes unhappy,

as negligence is sometimes glorious.


In ordering me to live joyfully,

you add more torments to my fears,

for I cannot, Phyllis, be obedient.


How shall I be able to hide from displeasures

if each person is martyr to the evil he feels,

and no one is architect of his tastes?

translation.title: Reply to Phyllis
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the reply's refusal of cheerful obedience under fate and temperament.
